record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, shorten causal readout pooling from the most recent four states to the most recent two, retaining the 0.8 current-state + 0.2 pooled-state blend. Short histories may benefit from less smoothing across older interests. Pool only observed prefix states during training and inference; retain final-real-position readout. Keep features, embeddings, causal blocks, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Update readout metadata and predictor-writer checks; retain one model per category.
